description: The Munich network. From Transportation Networks for Research, the traffic assignment test networks that continue H. Bar-Gera's TNTP collection: a directed road network with link capacities and free-flow times and an origin-destination trip table, in the files munich_net.tntp and munich_trips.tntp of the repository at commit d1639b4ef218.

licence.name: Transportation Networks for Research terms: academic research purposes only, with the source indicated in any publication

name: TNTP Munich traffic assignment network

recipe.reason: Its files do not follow the TNTP numbering: the network has no <FIRST THRU NODE>, one link line has another number of values than the header, and the trip table names destination zones such as 2146237932 outside 1 to its 742 zones, so the tntp parser refuses them. It becomes fetchable when the source renumbers its zones and nodes from 1.
